name: Supreme Court of India
address: Supreme Court of India, Tilak Marg, New Delhi - 110001
description: The Supreme Court of India is the apex court and the final court of appeal. Located in New Delhi, it has a Chief Justice and up to 33 other judges.

name: Allahabad High Court
address: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad, Prayagraj - 211001
description: The High Court of Judicature at Allahabad is one of the oldest and largest high courts in India, with jurisdiction over Uttar Pradesh. It also has a Lucknow Bench.

name: Bombay High Court
address: High Court of Bombay, Fort, Mumbai - 400032
description: The Bombay High Court has jurisdiction over Maharashtra, Goa, Dadra & Nagar Haveli, and Daman & Diu. Benches at Nagpur, Aurangabad (Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar), and Panaji.

name: Calcutta High Court
address: High Court at Calcutta, Esplanade Row West, Kolkata - 700001
description: The High Court at Calcutta is the oldest High Court in India with jurisdiction over West Bengal and the Andaman & Nicobar Islands. Has a circuit bench at Port Blair.

name: Delhi High Court
address: High Court of Delhi, Sher Shah Road, New Delhi - 110003
description: The Delhi High Court has jurisdiction over the National Capital Territory of Delhi. Known for handling high-profile commercial, constitutional, and criminal matters.

name: Madras High Court
address: High Court of Madras, High Court Road, Chennai - 600104
description: The High Court of Madras has jurisdiction over Tamil Nadu and Puducherry. Has a permanent bench at Madurai. One of the four original high courts of India.

name: Karnataka High Court
address: High Court of Karnataka, Ambedkar Veedhi, Bengaluru - 560001
description: The Karnataka High Court has jurisdiction over Karnataka state. Has benches at Dharwad and Kalaburagi. Located in the heritage High Court building in Bengaluru.

name: Kerala High Court
address: High Court of Kerala, Museum Road, Ernakulam, Kochi - 682031
description: The High Court of Kerala has jurisdiction over Kerala and the Union Territory of Lakshadweep. Located in Kochi (Ernakulam).

name: Gujarat High Court
address: High Court of Gujarat, Sola, Ahmedabad - 380060
description: The High Court of Gujarat has jurisdiction over the state of Gujarat. The new building is located at Sola, Ahmedabad.

name: Rajasthan High Court
address: High Court of Rajasthan, Residency Road, Jodhpur - 342001
description: The High Court of Rajasthan is the highest court in Rajasthan, with the principal seat at Jodhpur and a permanent bench at Jaipur.

name: Andhra Pradesh High Court
address: High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Nelapadu, Amaravati - 522503
description: The High Court of Andhra Pradesh was constituted in 2019 after the bifurcation of the combined HC. Currently located at Amaravati.

name: Telangana High Court
address: High Court for the State of Telangana, Hyderabad - 500066
description: The High Court for the State of Telangana was created in 2019 after bifurcation. Located at Nampally, Hyderabad.

name: Punjab and Haryana High Court
address: High Court of Punjab & Haryana, Sector 1, Chandigarh - 160001
description: The High Court of Punjab and Haryana has jurisdiction over Punjab, Haryana, and the Union Territory of Chandigarh.

name: Patna High Court
address: Patna High Court, Patna - 800001
description: Patna High Court has jurisdiction over Bihar state. It was separated from the Calcutta High Court in 1916.

name: Gauhati High Court
address: Gauhati High Court, Guwahati - 781001
description: The Gauhati High Court has jurisdiction over Assam, Nagaland, Mizoram, and Arunachal Pradesh. Has benches at Kohima, Aizawl, and Itanagar.

name: Orissa High Court
address: Orissa High Court, Cuttack - 753002
description: The Orissa High Court has jurisdiction over Odisha state, located in Cuttack.

name: Madhya Pradesh High Court
address: High Court of Madhya Pradesh, Jabalpur - 482001
description: MP High Court is at Jabalpur with benches at Gwalior and Indore. Chhattisgarh HC separated from this in 2000.

name: Chhattisgarh High Court
address: High Court of Chhattisgarh, Bilaspur - 495001
description: The Chhattisgarh High Court was established in 2000 when Chhattisgarh was carved out of Madhya Pradesh.

name: Uttarakhand High Court
address: High Court of Uttarakhand, Belvedere, Nainital - 263001
description: The Uttarakhand High Court is located in Nainital. It was constituted when the state was carved out of Uttar Pradesh in 2000.

name: Jharkhand High Court
address: High Court of Jharkhand, H.C. Road, Ranchi - 834002
description: The Jharkhand High Court was established in 2000 when Jharkhand was separated from Bihar. Located in Ranchi.

name: Himachal Pradesh High Court
address: High Court of Himachal Pradesh, Ravenswood, Shimla - 171001
description: The Himachal Pradesh High Court is located in Shimla, the summer capital. Has a bench at Dharamshala.

name: High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh
address: High Court of J&K and Ladakh, Srinagar (Summer) / Jammu (Winter)
description: Has jurisdiction over J&K and Ladakh UTs. Sits in Srinagar during summer and Jammu during winter.

name: Manipur High Court
address: High Court of Manipur, Imphal - 795001
description: The Manipur High Court was constituted as an independent HC in 2013, separated from the Gauhati High Court.

name: Meghalaya High Court
address: High Court of Meghalaya, Shillong - 793001
description: The Meghalaya High Court was constituted in 2013, separated from the Gauhati High Court.

name: Sikkim High Court
address: High Court of Sikkim, Gangtok - 737101
description: The Sikkim High Court is the smallest high court in India by caseload.

name: Tripura High Court
address: High Court of Tripura, Agartala - 799001
description: The Tripura High Court was constituted in 2013, separated from the Gauhati High Court.

name: Tis Hazari District Court
address: Tis Hazari Courts, Tis Hazari, Delhi - 110054
description: Tis Hazari Courts is the main civil and criminal district court complex in Delhi, one of the largest court complexes in Asia.

name: Patiala House Courts
address: Patiala House Courts, India Gate, New Delhi - 110001
description: Patiala House Courts handles cases related to the Central and New Delhi districts. Located near India Gate.

name: Karkardooma District Court
address: Karkardooma Courts, Vikas Marg, Delhi - 110092
description: Karkardooma Courts serves the East and North-East Delhi districts.

name: Saket District Court
address: Saket District Courts, Press Enclave Road, Saket, New Delhi - 110017
description: Saket District Court serves the South and South-West Delhi districts.

name: City Civil & Sessions Court Mumbai
address: City Civil & Sessions Court, Kala Ghoda, Fort, Mumbai - 400032
description: The City Civil & Sessions Court Mumbai is the principal civil court of original jurisdiction in Mumbai.

name: Pune District & Sessions Court
address: District & Sessions Court, Shivajinagar, Pune - 411005
description: The Pune District & Sessions Court is the principal court for Pune district.

name: Bangalore City Civil & Sessions Court
address: City Civil Court, Mayo Hall, Bengaluru - 560001
description: The Bangalore City Civil Court handles all original civil jurisdiction cases in Bengaluru city.

name: Bangalore Rural District Court
address: District Court, Bangalore Rural, Bengaluru
description: Handles cases for Bangalore Rural district.

name: Chennai City Civil Court
address: City Civil Court, High Court Buildings, Chennai - 600104
description: The Chennai City Civil Court is the principal civil court of original jurisdiction for Chennai.

name: Hyderabad City Civil Court
address: City Civil Court, Nampally, Hyderabad - 500001
description: The Hyderabad City Civil Court handles civil cases for Hyderabad district.

name: Ahmedabad City Civil & Sessions Court
address: City Civil Court, Lal Darwaja, Ahmedabad - 380001
description: The Ahmedabad City Civil Court is the principal civil court for Ahmedabad district.

name: Kolkata City Civil Court
address: City Civil Court, 2 Kiran Shankar Roy Road, Kolkata - 700001
description: The Kolkata City Civil Court handles civil original jurisdiction cases for Kolkata.

name: Jaipur District Court
address: District Court, Jaipur Metropolitan, Jaipur - 302001
description: The Jaipur District Court is the principal court for Jaipur Metropolitan area.

name: Lucknow District & Sessions Court
address: District Court, Lucknow - 226001
description: The Lucknow District Court handles cases for Lucknow district and serves as the seat of the Allahabad HC's Lucknow Bench.

name: Agra District & Sessions Court
address: District Court, Agra - 282001
description: Agra District Court handles cases for Agra district.

name: Ernakulam District Court
address: District Court, High Court Road, Ernakulam, Kochi - 682031
description: Ernakulam District Court is the busiest district court in Kerala, located in Kochi.
